name: Gemini Backend
description: Gemini backend for Level 3 translation and calibration. Provides integration with Google's Generative AI (Gemini) API for text completion tasks with configurable models and system instructions.

types.name: GeminiBackend

fields.name: _api_key
fields.description: Gemini API key from parameter or GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable

fields.name: _configured
fields.description: Flag indicating whether google.generativeai has been configured

types.description: Backend implementation for Google Gemini API integration. Manages API configuration, model selection, and text completion requests with lazy initialization pattern.

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Initialize GeminiBackend with API key and model configuration. Falls back to environment variables GEMINI_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL if parameters not provided. Sets internal configuration state to unconfigured.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: Gemini API key, falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Model identifier, falls back to TRANSMOG_MODEL environment variable or 'gemini-2.5-flash'

postconditions: self._api_key is set to api_key parameter or GEMINI_API_KEY env var or empty string
self._model is set to model parameter or TRANSMOG_MODEL env var or 'gemini-2.5-flash'
side_effects: reads environment variables GEMINI_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL

functions.name: _ensure_configured
functions.description: Lazy configuration method that configures the google.generativeai library with the API key on first call. Subsequent calls are no-ops. Mutates self._configured state.

error_cases.name: invalid_api_key
error_cases.condition: API key is invalid or empty when genai.configure is called

structured_side_effects.description: Configures genai library with API key (may trigger validation)

functions.name: complete
functions.description: Generate text completion using Gemini model. Extracts user messages from messages list, constructs prompt, and returns generated text. Uses zero temperature for deterministic output.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: System instruction for the model (set to None if empty string)

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: List of message dictionaries with 'role' and 'content' keys. Only 'user' role messages are extracted.

error_cases.name: api_error
error_cases.condition: Gemini API call fails (network, quota, invalid model, etc.)

error_cases.name: empty_messages
error_cases.condition: No user messages found in messages list
error_cases.error_type: ValueError or empty prompt may trigger API error

error_cases.name: response_blocked
error_cases.condition: Response blocked by safety filters or response.text unavailable

preconditions: messages contains at least one dict with keys 'role' and 'content'
messages with role='user' should have string 'content' field
postconditions: returns string response from Gemini model
side_effects: makes network call to Gemini API

invariants: self._configured transitions from False to True and never back to False
Default model is 'gemini-2.5-flash' if not overridden
Temperature is always 0 for deterministic output
Only user role messages are included in prompt construction
User messages are joined with double newlines

data_access.rationale: Reads GEMINI_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL environment variables for configuration fallback

side_effects.rationale: complete() makes HTTP requests to Google Gemini API for text generation
Reads environment variables in __init__ for API key and model configuration
